utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I might’ve missed the update. It’s Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep mentioning it to everyone I talk to.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep that in mind and check the details so I don’t miss anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — what still needs doing for the repair drive at the community center on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We still need to spread the word and get a quick list of needed repairs, then match folks to the urgent safety issues first. I can help keep track of who needs what.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Opal — I can help spread the word and gather the repair list so we can match people to the urgent safety fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — the repair drive is still on, now Sunday at the community center. I can help spread the word or make a quick needs list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice — I can help spread the word. Just send me the quick needs list and I’ll keep it short.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll put together a short needs list and send it over now. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — Sunday at the community center now, right? I’ll keep it simple and let folks know the update.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, Sunday at the community center. I’m a bit late, but I can help sort the biggest repairs and list the materials we still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, that helps a lot — I’ll tell people Sunday at the community center and keep the list of needed materials handy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got it — I’ll compare my notes and send over anything we’re still missing for the Sunday community center drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just to confirm, it’s still the Sunday drive at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — it’s still Sunday at the community center. I’ll check the supplies and send you the missing items.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, yes—please bring the wobbly chair by on Sunday at the community center. They should have room, and it’s exactly the kind of small fix that helps out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the wobbly chair by Sunday to the community center and make sure it gets looked at.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Gus — thank you for bringing it by Sunday at the community center. I’ll make sure they know to keep an eye out for your chair.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday at the community center works for me—what time should I tell folks to come by?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye — let’s tell folks to come by at 10 a.m. on Sunday. I’ll spread the word about the community center change too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll share 10 a.m. Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s list the biggest repairs first and what materials we need, then I’ll bring the tools Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — can you also tell me who’s coordinating the drop-off? I want to make sure everything goes to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can ask around and confirm who’s coordinating the drop-off. For now, let’s keep the list simple so nothing gets missed Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Uli — I can help with sorting donations at the community center on Sunday. Just point me to the pile and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’ll point you to the donation pile at the community center on Sunday — that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Uli — I’ll head over Sunday and look for the donation pile at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll check what I’ve got and let you know. And just to confirm, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. If you hear what they still need, let me know; I’m still piecing it together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll check and pass along anything I find.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’m still on for the repair drive. I can bring the basic tools and help sort donations; just let me know if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — thanks, Leo. It’s now Sunday at the community center, and we could still use gloves, tape, and any spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring gloves, tape, and a few spare tools on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina — we moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center. If you’re still able to help, I’d love you to join us there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can make Sunday at the community center. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what still needs fixing? I can help sort the biggest repairs and list the materials we need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — let’s start with the biggest fixes and the materials list, and I’ll send it over right away. We’re meeting Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great — I’ll focus on the biggest fixes and keep an eye out for the materials list at the community center Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm it’s still on for Sunday at the community center? I just want to make sure the time and entrance are set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s on for Sunday at the community center now. I’ll confirm the entrance and time next.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — please confirm the entrance and time when you can. I just want to make sure we’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just checking—are we still set for the repair drive on Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — the repair drive is still on for Sunday at the community center, and 2 o’clock at the side entrance works.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, 2 o’clock at the side entrance works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — we still need hands for sorting donations, checking tools, and simple repairs. If you’re free, I can slot you into whichever one helps most.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can sort donations and check the tools. Point me to where you want me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — head to the community center on Sunday, and I’ll point you to the donation sorting and tool check right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’m still hearing bits and pieces, so any update on what they need now would help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center, but I still need the exact drop-off spot and who’s coordinating so nothing ends up in the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — I’ll try to find out the exact drop-off spot and who’s coordinating, then I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the lot details over now. I really appreciate you coming by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send the details, and I’ll bring the tools and sort the donations. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, thank you, Bo. I’ll send the lot details right away and see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check the repair drive details, but what exactly do you want me to verify?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could you confirm it’s still Sunday at 2 o’clock at the community center side entrance? Also, we’re still looking for a ladder, a drill, and a few screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I’ll confirm it’s Sunday at 2 o’clock at the community center side entrance, and that you’re still looking for a ladder, a drill, and a few screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that helps — Sunday at the community center should be easier for me to coordinate around school pickup. Let me know the drop-off time when you have it, and I’ll keep the needed items in mind.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll check on the drop-off time and send you the missing items list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — I’ll keep Sunday at the community center in my schedule and watch for your update on the drop-off time and missing items.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, just a quick update—the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so it’s not at the front porch anymore. If you’ve got that wobbly chair, bring it along and they should be able to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I’ll make sure everyone knows it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the urgent repairs at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Rosa — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep passing the word, and if anyone has a last-minute fix, send them over on Sunday to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks — quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. I’ll send the details and a short list of what’s urgent.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center, got it. Just send me the list when you can, and I’ll help with whatever’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll send the list shortly, and thanks for jumping in on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Right, thanks for the update — let’s send everyone to the community center on Sunday and I’ll share that the drop-off point is there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll pass that along. If you still need it, I can check whether I’ve got a ladder, a drill, or some screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Rey — if you’ve got the ladder, drill, or screwdrivers, please bring them to the community center on Sunday. I’ll keep spreading the word so everyone knows where to go.
